The real callee set and constants match the already-recovered 0x03001eec subsystem cluster (080e7404.c, 080d59b0.c, 080d82b0.c, 080dc1ec.c, 080e01e4.c): Func_08004458() as the RNG (including several discarded-return-value calls, matching the established idiom in 080b88d0.c/080d59b0.c), Func_080cef64(flag, out_pair) filling a DrawRectangleFn[2] (matching 080e01e4.c's callback_ptr idiom, confirmed necessary here too -- the reference caches &callbacks[0] in a dedicated stack slot reloaded across the whole particle-processing section, not a fresh array-decay expression at every call site), and Func_080e0524's id argument spelled as (s32)&Value_000000cf (a pool-forced small link-time constant, matching the established Value_XXXXXXXX idiom -- 0xCF fits in movs but the reference loads it via ldr/pc, proving address-of-extern-byte, not a plain literal). Per games/gs1/recon/en/main/080e01e4.json's already-resolved derivation, every 'Func_080072f4' call here is the r4 slot of the _call_via_rN trampoline at games/gs1/asm/080072e4.s -- modeled as genuine indirect calls through DrawRectangleFn values read out of callback_ptr[idx] (idx = (j<=2)?1:0 in the ring-growth blit, idx = slot&1 in the promotion blit; both idx expressions read directly off the retained assembly's register trace, not guessed). Semantic recovery (see notes below) and the whole control-flow shape -- record-array init loop, per-member_count table-driven slot count/frame count (Data_080ee1f5[mc*2]/[mc*2+1], not the template's mc*16+48 formula), the record->8==1 growth-vs-promotion branch, the 16-entry sub-burst array, the extra-target Func_080d6888 loop -- were derived by hand-tracing every pc-relative literal load's resolved address (via the .lst byte offsets) and every register's provenance instruction-by-instruction; m2c's output was used as a cross-check but required correction in at least one place (the ip=4/0 ternary selecting callback_ptr[1] vs callback_ptr[0] by sl<=2 was represented in m2c's output as an empty dead if-block, since m2c lost track of the ip register). Once compiled, the algorithm and overall size are close (candidate=1100 vs reference=1132, an 8-word/32-byte gap) and no wrong-constant or wrong-branch-target defects were found while reading the full --align diff top to bottom -- every remaining mismatch is a register-letter/spill-slot or instruction-scheduling difference, cascading from one root cause: the reference keeps the OUTER per-frame loop counter (sp18, 'frame' here) in a stack slot and the INNER per-slot loop counter ('slot' here, bounded by the same Data_080ee1f5[mc*2] count used to gate the record-init loop) in fp for the whole function; this compiler's allocator instead gives fp to 'frame' and spills 'slot', which cascades into a further two extra 4-byte stack slots (candidate frame is sub sp,#48 vs reference's #40) and reorders/reschedules essentially every downstream instruction that touches either counter or anything spilled as a consequence (confirmed by reading the candidate's own generated out/dbg-080d3c80/080d3c80.s: 10 distinct stack-scalar slots vs the reference's 8, with the two extras being the promotion-loop's inner counter and the ring-growth sub-array base, both of which the reference keeps live in registers across their surrounding calls without a stack home). This is the exact same class of persistent, source-level-unresolved register-allocation-priority issue independently documented in 080e01e4.json note (b), 080dc1ec.json's sl/r9 swap, and 080d82b0.json/080d59b0.json -- not pursued further here per the ban on forcing register assignment or open-ended permutation search; tried and confirmed zero-effect: swapping the frame/slot local-declaration order (matched_prefix, candidate size, and every register choice were byte-identical before and after).

Semantic summary: grows an up-to-8-slot ring of particles at work + 0x7080 (28-byte records: [0]=x-base fixed-point<<16, [4]=accumulator (sentinel 0xFFC00000 until promoted, then compared/clamped against 0x380000), [8]=state (0=growing,1=promoted/bursting), [0xC]=random x-velocity term<<12 (sign/range depends on object mode field 4), [0x10]=unused after init, [0x18]=per-slot activation threshold = slot_index*8), one slot per Data_080ee1f5[member_count*2] table entry (also the record-array init loop bound). Each of Data_080ee1f5[member_count*2+1] animation passes: (a) if member_count==2 and frame<=103, nudges a u16 field at a global camera/screen struct (*(void**)0x03001E80 + 0x36) by a frame-dependent amount, direction chosen by the target object's mode field; (b) fires Func_080b50e8(0x86) at frame==total-80 and switches the work block's per-frame callback to a second constant (0x06060606) at frame==total-8; (c) for frame<=total-8, walks every active record: a record with state==1 (promoted) drives its own private 16-entry sub-burst array at 0x02010000+slot*0x1C0 through one _call_via_r4 indirect draw per entry (dest/width/height/src-offset all table-driven by an index built from two Func_080022fc/Func_080022ec calls) and steps its own [8]/[0x18] growth pair; a record with state==0 that has crossed its activation threshold gets one _call_via_r4 draw of its own (32x32, callback_ptr[slot&1]) and, once its accumulator crosses 0x380000, is promoted (state=1, accumulator pinned to 0x380000) and its whole 16-entry sub-array is freshly re-seeded from a 32-byte (16x2) offset table (Data_080ee1d3) plus two masked/negated RNG calls per entry (doubled/shifted differently when slot is odd), followed by work->0x77A8=8, Func_080f9010(144), and one Func_080d6888(member_id,7,5,idx,4) call per real party member if the target object has any (object field 0x14 != 0).

The per-member_count slot count and total frame count are direct table lookups (Data_080ee1f5[mc*2], [mc*2+1]) recomputed fresh at every comparison site throughout the function (5-6 separate re-reads, matching the reference's own repeated ldr/ldrb sequences rather than a cached local) -- consistent with this family's established 'no derived-pointer/value caching, fresh M2C_FIELD at every use site' convention; the one place the reference DOES cache a derived pointer across many call-heavy statements is `callback_ptr` (&callbacks[0], read back from a dedicated stack slot at four separate widely-separated points spanning the whole particle-processing section), matching 080e01e4.c's identical `DrawRectangleFn *callback_ptr` idiom.

Open, not-source-shape-controllable residual (see score.note for the full trace): this compiler's register allocator assigns fp to the outer frame-loop counter and spills the inner slot-loop counter, the reverse of the reference's choice, cascading into two additional stack-scalar slots and pervasive instruction-scheduling differences throughout the whole function body. This is the same class of issue independently documented as unresolved via source-level tuning in four sibling dossiers (080e01e4.json note b, 080dc1ec.json's sl/r9 finding, 080d82b0.json, 080d59b0.json) after each spent a full pass on targeted experiments; not re-litigated further here beyond the one direct declaration-order test recorded above.
